business_model_note: VENTURE-LENDING / growth-stage BDC (life sciences, technology, sustainable & renewable). Borrowers are largely pre-profit, VC/PE-backed companies whose repayment capacity rests on equity-raise access and liquidity events rather than EBITDA coverage. Loans are short (2-5yr), floating (Prime/SOFR-linked, ~7-14%), and carry contractual EXIT FEES (2.0-6.5% of principal) plus, on ~40% of the book, PIK toggles and attached warrants. Do NOT read HTGC PIK/non-accrual on a sponsor-backed middle-market cash-flow-lending yardstick: PIK here is often structured at origination as a yield component for pre-revenue borrowers, not a late-stage amend-and-extend concession.

portfolio_composition.note: SOI subtotals tie EXACTLY to the Consolidated Statements of Assets and Liabilities (cost $4,603,266K / FV $4,583,870K). Parser reconciled to the dollar on all four sleeves.
portfolio_composition.DECOMPOSITION_FINDING: Warrant/equity appreciation is NOT flattering the aggregate mark — it is DRAGGING it. Warrants carry +$16.0M unrealized appreciation but equity carries -$22.0M depreciation, so the equity+warrant sleeve NETS to -$6.0M. Debt standalone marks at 99.65% of cost, BETTER than the 99.58% blended figure. HTGC near-par aggregate is a debt-book result, not an equity-kicker artifact.
portfolio_composition.TREND_CAVEAT: Debt FV/cost fell from 100.36% (12/31/25) to 99.65% (6/30/26), a 71bp softening, while warrant FV/cost rose 123.06%->145.34%. The near-flat TOTAL (99.97%->99.58%) partially masks the debt-mark decline.

pik_detail.direction: PIK DOWN in both dollars (-9.5% YoY) and share of income (9.92% -> 8.28%).
pik_detail.ric_note: Filing states plainly that non-cash PIK "must be distributed to stockholders ... even though we have not yet collected any cash from the borrower," funded from cash or liquidations.

non_cash_income_ETP.HTGC_ETP_ANALOGUE: HTGC does not use the phrase "end-of-term payment." Its structural equivalent is the LOAN EXIT FEE — a contractual back-end fee (2.0%-6.5% of principal, visible per-loan in the SOI rate column) received at the earlier of maturity or prepayment, and ACCRETED into interest income by the effective-interest method before any cash is received. Economically non-cash accrued income, same as PIK.

noncash_accretion_per_cash_flow_stmt.note: Backed out as a non-cash reconciling item in operating cash flow, confirming non-cash character.

exit_fees_receivable.MATERIAL_NOTE: $43.6M of accrued-but-uncollected exit fees sit INSIDE the $4,391,637K debt cost basis, ~0.99% of debt cost. The FV/cost ratio is therefore measured against a cost base that already embeds accrued back-end fees.
exit_fees_receivable.COLLECTION_EVIDENCE: Receivable FELL $53.1M -> $48.0M over H1-2026 while $20.2M was accreted, implying roughly $25M collected in cash. Accrued exit fees are converting to cash, not compounding into an uncollected stub.

PIK_PLUS_ETP_COMBINED.ANSWER_TO_DIRECTIVE: YES — materially larger. PIK alone is 8.28% of investment income; PIK + exit-fee accretion is 19.17%, i.e. 2.3x the PIK-only figure. Roughly one dollar in five of HTGC investment income is non-cash-at-recognition. Judging HTGC on PIK alone understates non-cash income by ~11 points of investment income. Direction is nonetheless IMPROVING: 20.68% -> 19.17% YoY.
PIK_PLUS_ETP_COMBINED.partial_offset: Not all exit-fee income is non-cash: H1-2026 exit-fee income $30.9M vs $20.2M non-cash accretion, so ~35% was cash-realized on prepayments. A strict non-cash figure for Q2-2026 is therefore somewhat below 19.17%.

risk_rating_migration.CONVENTION: LOWER IS BETTER — filing states explicitly "with 1 being the highest quality." Grade 5 is worst.
risk_rating_migration.basis: Debt investments at FAIR VALUE; the weighted-average grade is stated on a COST basis.
risk_rating_migration.COMPARISON_CAVEAT: The 10-Q grading table compares 6/30/2026 to 12/31/2025 (two quarters), NOT to 3/31/2026. No QoQ grading migration is disclosable from this filing.
risk_rating_migration.DIRECTION_FINDING: BARBELL, not uniform drift. Top grade improved sharply: Grade 1 rose 15.9% -> 21.5% of portfolio (16 -> 21 companies), largely at the expense of Grade 2 (50.7% -> 43.9%). Simultaneously the tail deteriorated: Grade 4 went 3 -> 4 companies and Grade 5 went 0 -> 2 companies ($0 -> $5.5M). Combined Grade 4+5 is 1.9% of the debt book at FV vs 1.7% at 12/31/2025. Weighted-average improved because the top-end gain outweighs a small tail.
risk_rating_migration.company_count_note: Debt-holding portfolio companies rose 127 -> 136 over H1-2026.

Names are VERBATIM from the Consolidated Schedule of Investments as of 6/30/2026 for cross-manager matching. Amounts converted from the filing's $-thousands to raw USD. fv_pct_of_par uses DEBT fair value over DEBT par so the mark is not distorted by equity/warrant holdings; debt_cost/debt_fair_value are given separately for the same reason. Top 20 = $1,902,367K = 41.5% of portfolio FV. 228 portfolio companies in total.

structural_notes.management_structure: INTERNALLY MANAGED. Filing states HTGC "is an internally managed, non-diversified closed-end investment company." There is NO external adviser, NO base management fee and NO incentive fee payable BY HTGC. Costs appear as direct employee compensation ($22,303K in Q2-2026, incl. $3,937K stock comp) inside operating expenses. MATERIALLY DIFFERENT GOVERNANCE GEOMETRY vs externally-managed BDCs: there is no NII-keyed or FV-keyed fee that would reward inflating NII or marks. Any incentive-fee-driven mark-integrity hypothesis simply does not apply to HTGC.
structural_notes.incentive_fee_mechanics: NOT APPLICABLE to HTGC itself — no hurdle, no catch-up, no total-return lookback, no waiver, because there is no external fee arrangement. Incentive fees appear in the filing only in the OPPOSITE direction: HTGC OWNS the "Adviser Subsidiary" (Hercules Adviser LLC / Hercules Capital Management LLC / Hercules Partner Holdings LLC), a wholly-owned registered investment adviser held as a portfolio investment at fair value, which EARNS asset-based management fees and may earn incentive fees from privately offered Adviser Funds. $4,901K of expenses were ALLOCATED TO the Adviser Subsidiary in Q2-2026 ($9,530K H1), reducing HTGC net operating expenses.
structural_notes.asset_coverage: 212.2% excluding SBA debentures as of 6/30/2026, vs the 150% regulatory minimum elected by the Board (9/4/2018) and stockholders (12/6/2018) under Section 61(a)(2). 195.9% including SBA debentures. HTGC holds an SEC exemptive order permitting exclusion of all SBA leverage from the ratio. CUSHION: 62.2 points above the 150% floor on the regulatory measure, 45.9 points on the all-in measure.

unfunded_commitments.CONTINGENCY_NOTE: CRITICAL — this figure is NOT total contractual unfunded exposure. It counts ONLY commitments "available at the request of the portfolio company and unencumbered by future or unachieved milestones." Milestone-encumbered commitments (a large feature of venture lending, where tranches unlock on clinical/revenue/financing milestones) are EXCLUDED, as are commitments assigned to or directly committed by the Adviser Funds. True gross contractual commitment is therefore HIGHER than $408.2M by an amount the filing does not quantify.
unfunded_commitments.relief_provisions: Credit agreements generally contain provisions relieving HTGC of funding obligations where the borrower suffers materially adverse events. Filing notes many commitments may expire undrawn.
unfunded_commitments.fair_value: Filing deems the fair value of unfunded commitments immaterial (yields pegged to market indices).
unfunded_commitments.scale: Unfunded ($408.2M) equals 8.9% of portfolio FV and 18.0% of net assets.

leverage.subsequent_event: On 2026-07-24 HTGC issued $325.0M of 6.300% July 2031 Notes.

All investments Level 3 except holdings in publicly traded companies.

Derived figure carries rounding risk of +/-$0.01 since both inputs are rounded to cents.

Non-accrual FAIR VALUE and company COUNT are not given in the MD&A performing/non-accrual table, which discloses amortized cost only. FV ($5,519K) and count (2) were reconstructed by parsing SOI footnote-(8) rows and independently confirmed against the Grade-5 bucket of the portfolio-grading table. High confidence but reconstructed.

Non-accrual fair value and company count for the 12/31/2025 comparative are NOT disclosed (only $10.7M amortized cost / 0.2%). The Grade-5 bucket was zero at 12/31/2025, which is inconsistent with a non-zero non-accrual balance of $10.7M at cost; the 12/31/2025 non-accrual names were evidently graded 4 or better. FLAGGED as an unexplained cross-table tension in the PRIOR period; the CURRENT period ties cleanly.

Total GROSS contractual unfunded commitments (including milestone-encumbered tranches) are NOT quantified anywhere in the filing. Only the $408.2M unencumbered/available subset is disclosed. Searched "unfunded" across all 20 hits. This is a genuine undisclosed exposure for a venture lender, where milestone tranches are a core structuring feature.

Amounts of unfunded commitments related to loans assigned to or directly committed by the Adviser Funds are excluded from the $408.2M; the excluded dollar amount appears in the filing text at line 15066 but the numeric value did not survive text extraction cleanly and was NOT captured. Would require reading the inline-XBRL fact.

A strictly non-cash Q2-2026 income figure cannot be isolated: the cash-flow accretion adjustment for loan exit fees is disclosed only for the SIX-month period ($20,192K), not quarterly, while exit-fee income is disclosed quarterly ($16,245K). The 19.17% PIK+exit-fee share of investment income is therefore an UPPER bound on non-cash income for the quarter.

PIK income is not broken out between contractually-structured-at-origination PIK and PIK arising from amendments/restructurings. For a venture lender this distinction is the whole interpretive question, and the filing does not permit it.
No PIK-capitalized-balance disclosure (cumulative PIK added to principal) was found. SOI footnote (14) flags loans whose principal includes accumulated PIK but no aggregate dollar total is given.

Realized vs unrealized decomposition is disclosed in aggregate, not by portfolio company or by grade, so the driver of the Q1-2026 NAV dip and Q2 recovery cannot be attributed to specific credits from this filing.
Industry labels in top20 are taken from the SOI industry section headers. HTGC groups by sector header rather than SIC; labels are the filing's own taxonomy and are not normalized.
